info.description: Football match coordination platform for Dhaka, Bangladesh
info.title: Kick&Roar API

post.description: Authenticate user with email and password, returns access token and refresh token
Logout the current user and invalidate their session
Get a new access token using a valid refresh token
Create a new user account with email, password, full name, and phone

get.description: Get a list of matches with optional filters (status, date range, pagination)

parameters.description: Filter by status (open, full, cancelled, completed)
parameters.name: status

post.description: Create a new football match with venue, date, time, and other details

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific match

put.description: Update match details (only creator can update)

delete.description: Delete a match (only creator can delete)

post.description: Join a match as a participant
Leave a match that you previously joined

get.description: Get list of all participants for a specific match

post.description: Upload a profile image for the authenticated user (max 5MB, supports: jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp)

get.description: Get the authenticated user's profile information

put.description: Update the authenticated user's profile information (full_name, skill_level, profile_image_url, preferred_locations)

get.description: Get a user's profile information by their ID
Get statistics for a specific user (matches played, wins, etc.)
Get a list of all venues with pagination

post.description: Create a new football venue with location, facilities, and other details

get.description: Find venues within a specified radius from given coordinates

parameters.description: Filter by field type (futsal, football, astro)
parameters.name: field_type

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific venue

put.description: Update venue details (only owner can update)

post.description: Upload an image for a venue (only owner can upload)
